entries.summaryZh: 公元前647年，亚述国王亚述巴尼拔为报复埃兰人长期的袭扰，率军攻陷并摧毁埃兰都城苏萨。亚述军队掠走神庙与王宫财物，捣毁神像，并掘开埃兰历代王陵。此役后埃兰作为政治实体不复存在，亚述一度成为西亚唯一的霸主，但过度扩张也加速了其自身的衰落。
entries.summaryEn: In 647 BC the Assyrian king Ashurbanipal, retaliating for Elamite attacks, stormed and destroyed Susa, the Elamite capital. His army looted its temples and palaces, smashed the statues of its gods and desecrated the royal tombs; Elam ceased to exist as a political entity and Assyria briefly stood without a rival in western Asia.
entries.significanceZh: 苏萨之战终结了埃兰的独立，是亚述帝国扩张的顶点，也为其随后的迅速崩溃埋下伏笔。
entries.significanceEn: Susa ended Elamite independence and marked the height of the Assyrian empire, foreshadowing its own rapid collapse.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前166年春至前165年春之间，马加比起义初期，犹大·马加比率起义军在贝特霍伦山口伏击塞琉古将领塞隆的军队，将其击溃并追击至平原。此役是马加比起义早期的胜利，起义军随后又与阿波罗尼乌斯、吕西阿斯等部交战。具体日期史料未详，学界一般系于前166年。
entries.summaryEn: Between spring 166 and spring 165 BC, early in the Maccabean revolt, Judas Maccabeus ambushed and routed the Seleucid force of Seron in the Beth Horon pass and pursued the survivors into the plain. It was an early rebel victory, followed by further fighting against Apollonius and Lysias; the exact date is not recorded.
entries.significanceZh: 贝特霍伦之战是马加比起义早期的关键胜利，显示了游击战术在山地隘口的威力。
entries.significanceEn: Beth Horon was an early Maccabean victory that showed how effective guerrilla tactics were in the hill passes.

entries.summaryZh: 1072年1月初，卡斯蒂利亚国王桑乔二世在卡里翁德洛斯孔德斯附近的戈尔佩赫拉击败其弟莱昂国王阿方索六世，阿方索被迫流亡。此役是基督教诸王国之间的内斗，熙德也参与其中。桑乔随后兼并莱昂，但同年即在萨莫拉围城期间遇刺身亡，阿方索得以复位并统一两国王冠。
entries.summaryEn: In early January 1072 Sancho II of Castile defeated his brother Alfonso VI of Leon at Golpejera near Carrion de los Condes, forcing Alfonso into exile. The battle was an internecine struggle among Christian kingdoms in which El Cid also took part; Sancho absorbed Leon but was killed the same year at Zamora, and Alfonso recovered both thrones.
entries.significanceZh: 戈尔佩赫拉之战使桑乔二世短暂统一卡斯蒂利亚与莱昂，其遇刺又让阿方索六世成为两国的统治者。
entries.significanceEn: Golpejera briefly united Castile and Leon under Sancho II, whose murder then handed both crowns to Alfonso VI.

entries.summaryZh: 1641年3月11日，巴拉圭河上游的瓜拉尼人在耶稣会传教区组织武装，于姆波罗雷山附近击败来自圣保罗的葡萄牙带旗人及其图皮盟友。此役阻止了葡萄牙人沿河南下捕奴，保住了耶稣会传教区，也被视为乌拉圭河流域瓜拉尼人抵抗殖民扩张的重要胜利。
entries.summaryEn: On 11 March 1641 Guarani fighters organised in the Jesuit missions defeated a bandeirante force from Sao Paulo and its Tupi allies near Cerro Mborore on the upper Uruguay river. The victory stopped the Portuguese slave raids upriver, preserved the Jesuit missions and is remembered as a major Guarani resistance against colonial expansion.
entries.significanceZh: 姆波罗雷之战保住了耶稣会传教区，遏止了圣保罗带旗人向乌拉圭河流域的捕奴扩张。
entries.significanceEn: Mborore preserved the Jesuit missions and halted the bandeirante slave raids into the upper Uruguay basin.

entries.summaryZh: 1900年6月11日至12日，第二次布尔战争期间，英军在德兰士瓦中部的钻石山（布尔人称唐克胡克）进攻布尔军队阵地。英军以骑兵迂回迫使布尔人撤退，约翰内斯堡与比勒陀利亚之间的布尔防线被突破，但布尔人避免了被合围。此役后战事转入游击阶段。
entries.summaryEn: On 11 and 12 June 1900, during the Second Boer War, British forces attacked the Boer position at Diamond Hill, known to the Boers as Donkerhoek, in the central Transvaal. A cavalry flanking move forced the Boers to withdraw and broke their line between Johannesburg and Pretoria, though the Boers escaped encirclement.
entries.significanceZh: 钻石山之战突破了布尔人在德兰士瓦中部的防线，此后战争由正规战转入长期游击战。
entries.significanceEn: Diamond Hill broke the Boer line in the central Transvaal and pushed the war into its long guerrilla phase.

entries.summaryZh: 1900年3月7日，第二次布尔战争期间，英军在白杨树丛（布尔人称莫德河渡口）以骑兵迂回攻击布尔军队，布尔人未作有力抵抗即溃退。此役紧随金伯利解围之后，为英军进军布尔首都布隆方丹打开道路。布尔指挥官德韦特在回忆录中把这一章称为从白杨树丛的狂逃。
entries.summaryEn: On 7 March 1900, during the Second Boer War, British cavalry and mounted infantry outflanked the Boer force at Poplar Grove and the Boers fled without a real fight. The action followed the relief of Kimberley and opened the way to Bloemfontein; the Boer commander Christiaan de Wet titled the chapter on it Wild Flight from Poplar Grove.
entries.significanceZh: 白杨树丛之战使英军得以向布隆方丹推进，也暴露了布尔军队在正规战中的组织弱点。
entries.significanceEn: Poplar Grove opened the British advance on Bloemfontein and exposed the Boers' organisational weakness in conventional fighting.

entries.summaryZh: 1966年1月8日至14日，越南战争期间，美军与澳大利亚军队在平阳省古芝以北发起卷发行动，目标是被认为藏有越共指挥部的地道网络。联军在激战后发现并部分清剿了长达两百余公里的地道系统，双方伤亡都不小。这是当时南越战场上规模最大的一次联军行动，也是首次师级作战。
entries.summaryEn: From 8 to 14 January 1966, during the Vietnam War, American and Australian forces mounted Operation Crimp north of Cu Chi in Binh Duong Province against a suspected Viet Cong headquarters concealed underground. After heavy fighting they uncovered and partly cleared a tunnel network of more than 200 kilometres, the largest allied operation in South Vietnam to that date.
entries.significanceZh: 卷发行动首次大规模发现越共地道体系，促使美军此后组建专门的地道作战部队。
entries.significanceEn: Crimp was the first large-scale discovery of the Viet Cong tunnel system and led the Americans to create dedicated tunnel warfare units.

entries.summaryZh: 2004年春，伊拉克战争期间，美军第4海军陆战团第2营在安巴尔省首府拉马迪与叛乱武装激战。当时费卢杰正被围困，叛乱分子试图在拉马迪开辟战线以分散联军兵力。四天的战斗中有约250名叛乱分子被打死，此后半年美军又有34名陆战队员和1名海军医护兵阵亡。
entries.summaryEn: In the spring of 2004, during the Iraq War, the 2nd Battalion, 4th Marines fought insurgents in Ramadi, capital of Anbar Province, while Fallujah was under siege and the insurgents tried to open a second front. About 250 insurgents were killed over four days, and in the following six months 34 Marines and a Navy corpsman died in the city.
entries.significanceZh: 2004年拉马迪之战是伊拉克战争中美军与叛乱武装在安巴尔首府反复拉锯的开端。
entries.significanceEn: The 2004 battle of Ramadi opened the long urban contest between American forces and insurgents in Anbar's capital.

entries.summaryZh: 2007年1月，埃塞俄比亚入侵索马里期间，埃塞俄比亚国防军与索马里过渡联邦政府民兵在美国空中力量支援下进攻基斯马尤以南的拉斯坎博尼，这里是被逐出摩加迪沙的伊斯兰法院联盟最后的城镇据点。战斗于1月6日开始，1月12日该镇被攻占，美国在此期间对疑似基地组织目标实施空袭。
entries.summaryEn: In January 2007, during the Ethiopian invasion of Somalia, Ethiopian and Transitional Federal Government forces with American air support attacked Ras Kamboni near the Kenyan border, the last urban stronghold of the Islamic Courts Union after its retreat from Mogadishu. The assault began on 6 January, the town fell on 12 January, and the United States struck suspected al-Qaeda targets.
entries.significanceZh: 拉斯坎博尼之战终结了伊斯兰法院联盟的有组织抵抗，巩固了过渡联邦政府在索马里的地位。
entries.significanceEn: Ras Kamboni ended organised Islamic Courts Union resistance and consolidated the transitional government's position in Somalia.

entries.summaryZh: 公元66年，第一次犹太-罗马战争初期，叙利亚总督加卢斯率第十二军团及辅助部队自耶路撒冷撤退途中，在贝特霍伦隘口遭犹大起义军伏击。罗马军队惨败，约六千人阵亡，军团鹰旗被缴获。此役极大鼓舞了起义，导致犹太短暂自治，也迫使罗马此后投入更多兵力镇压。
entries.summaryEn: In 66 CE, early in the First Jewish-Roman War, the legate of Syria Cestius Gallus and his Legio XII Fulminata were ambushed by Jewish rebels in the Beth Horon pass while retreating from Jerusalem. Some 6,000 Roman troops were killed and the legion's eagle was captured; the defeat encouraged the revolt and forced Rome to commit far larger forces.
entries.significanceZh: 贝特霍伦之战是第一次犹太-罗马战争中罗马最惨重的失败之一，直接延长并扩大了起义。
entries.significanceEn: Beth Horon was one of Rome's worst defeats in the First Jewish-Roman War and directly prolonged and widened the revolt.
